lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters are arranged in a multi-linear horizontal configuration posterior to the gills, with a transition from dense, smaller points near the head to larger, more spaced clusters along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor system across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance transition with a highlight on the superior edge and a deep shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least six remoras is visible attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
